description: This file is a BitBake recipe snippet for building the Vim text editor, including configuration, compilation, installation, and packaging instructions.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Configures the build environment by preparing autotools in the src directory.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Compiles Vim, setting up locale files and running autotools compilation.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs Vim, adjusts permissions, installs example configs, and modifies runtime files based on features.
